title: The Pitfall of Fire Precautions
notes: Detective-cast (Conan, Haibara, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, Kogoro) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Discrepancy vs. the old lower-fidelity `cases/ep803...json` file: it claimed 'No human victim (property arson) so no motive/knows edges are generated' -- this is wrong. The transcript is explicit that the original run of arsons a year earlier had a fatal casualty (an office worker who wrapped himself in a plastic equipment-repair sheet at the fourth site and died), which is both the reason the original spree stopped and the reason Kamaishi (a burglar who witnessed it but never came forward) is driven to catch the arsonist himself this time. The old file's murderer_id (Harue Yatabe / s2) is correct and matches the transcript. case_type: arson (with one prior-year fatality).

clues.desc: Burned characters at sites 1-4, read backward, spell 'Iroha' -- matching the 'Iroha Toys' brand stamped on all the burned equipment -- pointing to the toy factory as the fifth and final target.
The fleeing arsonist is left-handed, matching both Kamaishi and Yatabe, but only Yatabe can drive the delivery van used to reach the factory -- narrowing it to her.
